name: EBR Systems, Inc.
summary: EBR Systems, Inc., established in 2003 and based in Sunnyvale, California, develops implantable medical devices that stimulate tissue wirelessly. Its main product is the WiSE cardiac resynchronization therapy system, which delivers pacing signals wirelessly inside the left ventricle, avoiding problems of conventional pacing leads such as complex insertion, unintended nerve activation, displacement and removal.
